t: For expenses of family housing for the Navy and Marine Corps for construction, including acquisition, replacement, addition, expansion, extension, and alteration, as authorized by law, $94,011,000, to remain available until September 30, 2021.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation for Navy and Marine Corps family housing construction. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading; the phrase "as authorized by law" refers only to existing statutory authority.
fable.s: For expenses of family housing for the Navy and Marine Corps for construction, including acquisition, replacement, addition, expansion, extension, and alteration, as authorized by law, $94,011,000, to remain available until September 30, 2021.
